title: CD Shoot animation cadence
symptom: The hovered language flag and later skeets animate much too quickly.
expected: Guest animation cadence remains synchronized with the 50 Hz player.
revalidation_reason: The report predates the ac20dcd cold-power-cycle checkpoint. Its timing hypothesis remains technically relevant, but behavior on that checkpoint or a later build has not been reconfirmed.

hypotheses.hardware_explanation: Legacy SCC68070 instruction timing lets guest animation logic perform too much work per MCD212 frame. Restoring section-6.2 timings without cycle/event-interleaved device advancement is insufficient because that historical combination regressed The 7th Guest.
supporting_evidence: The section-6.2 timing implementation in 191eebb corrected this cadence.
Commit 18beb7f restored legacy timing to preserve The 7th Guest under the current instruction-boundary scheduler.
contradicting_evidence: The current ac20dcd build has not yet been manually retested for this symptom.
hypotheses.falsifying_test: Reproduce flag and skeet cadence on ac20dcd, then test accurate SCC68070 timing only after device events can advance within long instructions.

manual_verification.notes: User reported that the previously corrected fast language-flag animation had returned.
